hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git fetch --quiet && LOCAL=$(git rev-parse @) && REMOTE=$(git rev-parse @{u} 2>/dev/null) && if [ "$LOCAL" != "$REMOTE" ]; then git pull --rebase --autostash 2>&1 | tail -3; else echo '[boat] already up to date'; fi

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && CHANGES=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && UNPUSHED=$(git log @{u}.. --oneline 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && if [ "$CHANGES" != "0" ]; then echo "[boat] ⚠️  $CHANGES uncommitted change(s). Run /sync to commit & push."; elif [ "$UNPUSHED" != "0" ]; then echo "[boat] ⚠️  $UNPUSHED unpushed commit(s). Run: git push"; fi
